purpose: Test whether raw GMOS spectra support a covariance-complete stellar kinematic profile to 36.0 kpc, the radius fixed by the third independent-family strong-lens image before any spectral pixel was reduced.
forbidden_inputs_at_freeze: digitized values from the published A2261 velocity or dispersion panels
any gravity, mass, lens-model, dark-matter, negative-gravity, void, or fitted residual
any post-fit change to the 36-kpc support, spatial bins, fit windows, bootstrap construction, or pass thresholds

software_environment.baseline_reduction_engine: DRAGONS 4.2.2 in the existing isolated Python 3.12 conda environment

bad_pixel_mask.selection: Archive GMOS-N EEV full-frame 2x2 three-amplifier BPM valid from 2001-08-01, preceding the March 2008 science dates.
bad_pixel_mask.fallback: Stop if the archive BPM cannot be provenance-matched; do not synthesize a mask after viewing science residuals.

detector_and_2d_reduction.bias: Overscan-correct and sigma-clipped-median combine the five same-night biases; never mix nights.
detector_and_2d_reduction.flat_arc: Process each mapped GCAL flat and CuAr arc individually; do not stack across mappings or nights.
detector_and_2d_reduction.science: Bias subtract, flat correct, mosaic, wavelength calibrate, distortion correct, propagate variance/DQ, and cosmic-ray flag each exposure separately.
detector_and_2d_reduction.sky_fit: Per-wavelength inverse-variance linear spatial model with three iterations of 4-sigma clipping.
detector_and_2d_reduction.combination: Register by continuum centroid only, resample once, inverse-variance combine with 4-sigma clipping, and retain all four individual calibrated frames.

calibration_acceptance.failure_policy: Any failed threshold ends this reconstruction. Do not remove frames or change apertures, windows, mappings, or thresholds after a velocity or dispersion is seen.

continuum_center_fit.joint_model: Shared Moffat center, alpha, and beta with one nonnegative amplitude and constant per exposure

spatial_extraction.signed_bin_retention: All nine signed bins, including both outer 7.0-10.5 arcsec bins, must pass S/N and valid-pixel gates. One-sided detector coverage is not sufficient.
spatial_extraction.symmetrized_output: After side-consistency gates, generalized least-squares combine four opposite-side pairs plus the central bin into five radial bins with a full 5x5 covariance.

stellar_kinematic_fit.lsf: Measure an arc-line FWHM spline in 200-Angstrom bins and forward-convolve XSL templates; never apply a negative correction.
fixed_masks: all nonzero DQ and nonpositive variance pixels
chip-gap and combined-coverage pixels with fewer than three exposures
5577 Angstrom sky line plus or minus 8 Angstrom
pixels exceeding a local 21-pixel variance median by 6 robust sigma

covariance_protocol.joint_resampling: Resample four calibrated exposures with replacement; use shared eight-pixel spectral Rademacher blocks across all signed bins; perturb the continuum center, wavelength solution, and LSF from their pre-kinematic covariances.

profile_acceptance.external_publication_check: Only after all gates are recorded may the published panel be digitized as a validation control; it may never tune or replace the raw result.

stage_outcomes.outcome: Provenance-matched EEV BPM and exact DRAGONS/pPXF environment manifest.
stage_outcomes.advance_if: Every science, flat, arc, bias, and BPM is recognized without header edits under DRAGONS 4.2.2/pPXF 9.4.8.
stage_outcomes.rethink_if: Stop with a software/calibration shortfall; do not hand-edit metadata.

stage_outcomes.outcome: Four independently calibrated 2-D spectra with propagated variance/DQ and all three pre-frozen sky variants.
stage_outcomes.rethink_if: Any bias, flat, wavelength, centroid, coverage, or sky threshold fails; replace A2261 rather than tune it.

stage_outcomes.outcome: Nine signed bins through 10.5 arcsec, five radial bins, 200-replicate covariance, and the frozen 27-run systematics grid.
stage_outcomes.advance_if: All nine bins and all uncertainty, side-consistency, covariance, and <=10% systematic-shift gates pass, leaving at least three preidentified lens families inside at least 36.0 kpc realized support.
stage_outcomes.rethink_if: Any outer bin, stability gate, or 36-kpc overlap condition fails; retain A2261 as a failed extended-kinematics attempt and select a fresh residual-blind candidate.

post_P2b_protocol_amendment.basis: The center model and fit support were frozen before reduction, but the continuum-collapse interval was omitted as a clerical detail. The interval matches the previously frozen A1689 continuum-only engineering method and was fixed after P2b header/provenance audit but before any A2261 continuum collapse, spatial profile, center, sky value, spectrum, velocity, or dispersion was inspected.
